sources: https://developer.nps.gov/api/v1/campgrounds?parkCode=meve (NPS campground record: fees, sites, amenities, reservation info, coordinates)

values.note: Dry tent/RV sites $38, the 15 full-hookup sites $51, a night for two people; extra persons age 6+ pay more. Senior/Access passes apply to the site the holder occupies. The booking engine shows the same $38 / $51 for June 2027. Mesa Verde locations are cash-free.

fees.source: https://book.visitmesaverde.com/lodging/supplier/30085691 (2027-06-15: 'Dry Site' 24-49 FT $38/night, 'Full Hook Up' 35-49 FT $51/night) + https://developer.nps.gov/api/v1/campgrounds?parkCode=meve (Dry Camping '38.00 ... based on double occupancy'; Full Hook-Up '51.00'; 'Senior and Access passes apply to all camping'), read 2026-10-27

hookups.source: https://www.visitmesaverde.com/stay/morefield-campground ('15 full hook-up RV sites with water, electric, and sewer'), read 2026-10-27; amperage not stated

values.note: 267 sites: 15 full-hookup RV sites, 17 group tent sites, the rest dry tent/RV sites (85 tent-only per the NPS record). The booking engine lists dry sites by length class 24-49 ft and full-hookup sites 35-49 ft, but the concessioner says RVs longer than 46 ft are not allowed.

sites.source: https://www.visitmesaverde.com/stay/morefield-campground ('267 in total'; 'NOTE: Morefield RV & Campground does not allow RV's longer than 46''; '17 group sites each accommodating up to 25 guests in tents only') + https://developer.nps.gov/api/v1/campgrounds?parkCode=meve (totalSites 267, tentOnly 85, rvOnly 15, rvMaxLength 46) + booking engine site classes, read 2026-10-27

values.note: All seasonal. Free dump station; showers and coin laundry beside the Campground Store; high-speed internet throughout the loops. No cell reception.

facilities.source: https://www.visitmesaverde.com/stay/morefield-campground ('Showers & Laundry - Adjacent to Campground Store'; 'Dumping Station - Free'; 'well-stocked grocery and camp store'; 'potable water near campsites'; 'high-speed internet is available throughout all site loops') + https://developer.nps.gov/api/v1/campgrounds?parkCode=meve (toilets 'Flush Toilets - seasonal'; cellPhoneReception 'No'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: 2026 operating dates April 24 - October 18. Off-season primitive camping with no services about a week either side (2026: April 16-24 and October 19-25); closed November to late April.

season.source: https://www.visitmesaverde.com/stay/morefield-campground ('Operating Dates April 24 - October 18'; 'Winter Closure October 19 at 10:00 am'; 'Primitive Camping Dates ... Off-season limited camping - no service offered. Spring: April 16 - April 24, Fall: October 19 - October 25') + NPS campground record ('Closed for the Season' 2026-11-03 to 2027-04-24), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Run by the park concessioner, Aramark: book online, at 1-800-449-2288, or at the Campground Store. Reservations are accepted but not required for the dry sites; highly recommended for the 15 full-hookup sites. Check in at the Campground Store for a site assignment. 14 consecutive nights and 14 total nights a calendar year.

booking.source: https://developer.nps.gov/api/v1/campgrounds?parkCode=meve (reservationInfo: 'managed by park concessionaire, Aramark. Reservations are accepted but not required. Reservations are highly recommended for one of the 15, RV full hook-up sites ... online at www.visitmesaverde.com, by calling 1-800-449-2288, or at the Morefield Campground Store') + https://www.visitmesaverde.com/stay/morefield-campground ('Nearly 267 dry tent/RV sites (reservations accepted, not required)'; 'no more than 14 consecutive nights and no more than 14 total nights in a calendar year'), read 2026-10-27

note: Mesa Verde NP campground in Morefield Canyon, 4.5 mi inside the park entrance, among Gambel oaks; deer and wild turkeys. Trailers/towed vehicles not permitted beyond the campground. Concessioner-run (Aramark). --Claude
summary: Concessioner page + its booking engine + NPS campground record: confirmed 267 sites, 46-ft limit, water/sewer at the 15 full-hookup sites, $38 / $51 (also for June 2027), dump, store. Added showers, laundry, flush toilets, water, wifi, season April 24 - October 18 with off-season primitive weeks, booking URL, some walk-up (dry sites need no reservation), 14-night max. Amperage not stated anywhere. Note: dropped the count/length/amenity/booking/season restatements.
